Material origin: REPLACE with original or imported-or-adapted

## Contribution and rights holders

Describe the change and identify all authors, co-authors and any employer or
client owning rights. Identify the applicable individual CLA and any corporate
authorisation; do not publish signed agreements or private identity documents.
Identify earlier submissions that need inclusion in the signed execution schedule.

## Imported or adapted material

For each import or adaptation, identify the upstream project and URL, exact
revision or source, affected paths and modifications, actual licence text,
copyright notices and obligations. Link the tracked provenance/licence record.
State "None" for entirely original material.

## Validation

Describe the focused validation relevant to the change.
